name: Day Night Toggle
description: A switch drawn as a small snow landscape where the sun sets behind the ridge, the moon rises and the stars come out.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label to the right of the switch. Without it the switch is named "Night" unless you pass aria-label.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Night when true (controlled). Use defaultSelected when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with true for night and false for day. The switch never changes the page theme itself.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the switch and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components SwitchField.
